title: await in a loop runs one by one
why_it_matters: Sometimes that is right, and sometimes it is slow.
explanation: An await inside a for loop pauses each round, so tasks run one after another. That's correct when order matters or the next step needs the last result. For independent requests, start them together with Promise.all and your total wait shrinks a lot.
try_it: Rewrite slow() with Promise.all and map so it takes about 200ms.
